_comment: Measured 2026-09-15 against Kal-Voe/Survey (private repo, GitHub Free plan) with
`repos/.../actions/runs/{id}/jobs`. Billed minutes are computed the way GitHub
bills them: per JOB, ceil(wall seconds / 60), minimum 1.
The /timing endpoint answers billable.UBUNTU.total_ms = 0 on this account, so job
start/complete timestamps are the source. Independently cross-checked with
`gh run list --workflow=ci.yml -L 1000` (116 CI runs in the window).
